newsitem.title: USA: Stone Container sells $275 mln debt units.
newsitem.headline: Stone Container sells $275 mln debt units.

text.p: The following debt issue from corrugated container, paperboard and newsprint maker Stone Container Corp was priced on Thursday, according to lead manager Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities.
The issue was priced in units consisting of 10-3/4 percent senior subordinated debentures and 1-1/2 percent supplemental interest certificates.
The offering is part of a $700 million funding program announced by Stone last week. Stone said the funding plan will meet its financing and debt amortization needs and restore appropriate liquidity.
The deal was increased in size by $25 million, DLJ said.
